policy: Continuous: independent automatic source-build, data admission, preview, publication or sync; application tests are executed automatically only by application-architecture.yml. Manual: explicit targeted replay of a focused check. Historical: frozen original evidence, opt-in only and never a current release gate.

continuous.builtin-country-deployment.yml: Source-matched country publication and pinned data admission
continuous.generated-artifacts-p2.yml: Changed runtime asset generation and immutable publication
continuous.gis-native-hydro.yml: Independent Hydro native source build and focused verification
continuous.gis-natural-global-world.yml: One-time six-LOD natural-color source candidate producer; immutable external work/gis only, never a runtime pin or deployment
continuous.gis-natural-surface-preview.yml: Bounded natural-surface candidate generation, external work/gis storage and immutable readback; delegates selected checks to the canonical runner
continuous.gis-natural-viewer-gate.yml: Focused real-browser external natural tile acceptance with screenshots and WebGL/Canvas parity; distinct from application source-matched checks
continuous.hydro-packfile-runtime-gate.yml: Atomic range and Hydro packet acceptance
continuous.p1-gpu-zoom-ab.yml: Source-paired P1-1 zoom performance measurements on work/ui only; no publication or application release gating
continuous.place-curated-release.yml: Curated place data generation and publication
continuous.shared-core.yml: Separate native C++ source build and WASM identity
continuous.viewer-preview.yml: Preview artifact producer; delegates application checks
continuous.web-pages.yml: Production Pages deployment and live acceptance

delegatedToCanonical.terrain-runtime-gate.yml: Application Architecture selects terrain unit contracts and Viewer runtime metadata identity by changed source paths.
delegatedToCanonical.world-archive-retirement-integrity.yml: Application Architecture selects world manifest/closure tests, externally stored assets boundary and Viewer source-pinned identity.
